decision: proceed: issued artefact readers do not compare their digest with a new registry capture

Vertical resolution reads building, floor and space. Scope pagination enumerates captured records; it requires no unrelated record.
Stored manifest and selected membership; recapture before new prepare/commit. No additional body dependency.

Target evidence sources; captured project identity with code/status/location/successor ids and historicalAliases. Successor bodies are disclosed only if independently selected; do not add unselected successors.
SourceOnly evidence source at its original revision/hash.
Exact selected source-only spaces, recorded parent floors and buildings, then building-feature import-package document pins.
Selected records, site.frame, evidence/rights/geometry.bindings sources. No other site field.
Captured target identity status only. Feature/import-package/map-area input pins are checked against current tables, not snapshot members.
Target and exact linked evidence source bodies/referenceParts; retained manifest on packet disclosure, never a new capture.

Target with aliases/identity/successor ids; selected sources with package referenceParts; shared declarations and all their contributing source evidence. Source ancestry is read from current sources for authorization, not from snapshot bodies.
Captured declaration membership, delegates selected declaration dependencies to readSelectedDeclaration.
Selected target, its captured committed document/image citations, or source-statement original. Target history is checked in registry_revisions; no whole-manifest recapture.
Captured source-only target and sourceOnly.evidence original, with original hash/body integrity.
Target, selected source bodies for parcel evidence, selected shared declarations, and source-only parent floor/building via card-source-facts.
Space.sourceOnly.parentId floor and Space.sourceOnly.buildingId building; floor identifier and source-only literals, building name.
Retained manifest authorization only; delegates plan/card checks. No additional members.
Every contributing declaration source body; copied-source ancestry checked live, not as captured members.

Declaration covering a target, complete input population/entry pins for eligibility, all declaration entry bodies for integrity, target applicability/relationPath, instrument/population/denominator/entry/consent/applicability sources. Unselected population members make packetState not_assessed, not a false complete claim.
Target, evidence/rights/geometry.bindings/registryMetadata sources and asserted IFC/document citations. Snapshot sources seed live authorization lineage; no need to capture ancestry separately.
Building area_feature member for listing and aggregate member/freshness counts; no unrelated features.
Stored manifest access/policy and review linkage only; no additional body dependency.
Delegates retained manifest read, no additional dependency.

writers.raises: Any reviewed registry draft records a new site revision.
Any identity assignment/mutation increments site revision.
Protocol control of the source-space writer; real child writer reads the current site revision in ingestion/source-building-children.ts:43.

fields_read.fields: site.frame in digest; frame.id/benchmark/horizontalUnit in manifest
Generic readSnapshotBody returns the captured site body, but no production semantic consumer uses its name/revision/seed fields.

site_revision.target_site_member: body {id,identifier,frame}, pin revision 0; retain the entire frame. Site snapshots keep the whole row and real revision.

schema.note: No trigger: revision is raised explicitly by writers. Frame can also change without a revision bump (officer/officer-preparation.ts:369).

artefacts.comparison: pinnedManifest current.digest !== manifest.digest before assignment/new mutation; an unconsumed review needs a new capture and review after rollout.
Replay and resolution retain stored manifests. A correction/retirement is a NEW reviewed operation (302), not verification of the earlier assignment.
fresh compares before new prepare/review/commit; accepted read/receipt replay use retained bodies. Uncommitted proposals/reviews need a new capture.
New prepare/commit compares captures; cached successful commit returns before recapture. Uncommitted proposals need a new capture.
Read/replay uses authorizePlanTx. New confirm/execute reassess only target/source/entry hashes, not a fresh registry snapshot digest; no rollout recapture required.
Retained manifest/plan and byte hash only. PDF reader delegates retained PDF plan (packets/pdf-authority.ts:139-148).
Stored card/plan/packet linkage and hashes, live access/lifecycle; current target revision is reported separately. Same-context new card revision can retain old manifest.

Six retained integrity/linkage checks; snapshotTx reports current target revision. No capture. Verification remains private local-operator authority despite the QR/resolver route; no public-access expansion.

stop_rule.reason: No issued artefact verification/replay compares a new registry capture digest. Never rewrite existing manifests, bodies or digests.

source_stated_rows.needs: Selected spaces at exact revisions, parent floors and buildings at current recorded revisions in the same site. Parent floor sourceOnly.buildingId must match the building. It queries feature-associated geometryFree import packages for all documentPins and checks conflicts. Keep function unchanged; feed it the closure records.

declaration_rows.today: Latest revision of every declaration in site (max ten), then every entry and applicability child at that declaration revision (max 100 of each). Entries name body.entry.target; applicability names body.target; declarations name input.population.targets and input.entries[].target.
declaration_rows.restriction: Select only declarations whose population, entry or applicability target is a closure record. Keep all entries of that relevant declaration because service.ts:318-325 checks all; restrict applicability to closure targets. Include all contributing sources because service.ts:306-307 authorizes the entire declaration. This extends the initial sources/entries rule for demonstrated readers, not unrelated site data.
declaration_rows.eligibility_caveat: Do not silently add sibling population records to a one-target capture. Shared packet eligibility is honestly not_assessed unless all population/entry/path pins are already in the chosen closure; broad population selection still works.

closure: Selected registry records and recursively named sourceOnly parent/building plus links within/floor/serves/crosses (snapshots.ts:317-321).
Associated recorded physical features; feature import-package document pins; sourceStatedOriginal pins unchanged.

Sources cited by record/feature evidence, rights evidence, geometry bindings, metadata and document/IFC citations; sources contributing to relevant declarations. Their existing package parts are restricted by source id.
Current qualifications of closure records/features; relevant declarations and their entry bodies, target applicability.
Aliases and split/merge successor ids only of closure records, inside existing record projection; no independent alias/lineage members or unselected successor bodies.
Stable site member. No case, map_area, import_package, job or copied-source ancestry members: readers authorize those against their existing live stores.
